info.name: Cassini
info.summary: Record, transcribe and search Nextcloud Talk meetings on your own hardware.
info.description:
> 🌱 **Early release, feedback welcome.** We run Cassini daily on our own Nextcloud, but expect rough edges. Tell us what works and what breaks in [GitHub issues](https://github.com/codemyriad/gocassini/issues).
> 👀 **Try it first.** Start a call with friends or colleagues on [demo.gocassini.com](https://demo.gocassini.com), press Record, and explore what was said.
Nextcloud Talk calls, recorded and transcribed on your own hardware. Build on everything your team says without handing it to a third party.
## What you get
- 🎙️ **The same Record button.** Works in any Talk room, group calls and 1:1. Cassini is the recording server behind it. - 📝 **A name on every line.** Each Talk participant becomes a named speaker, so transcripts show real names. If several people share one laptop, Cassini can separate their voices and you label each one. - 🔎 **Search and tags** across all your meetings. - 💬 **Ask your meetings.** Optional summaries and questions across meetings, once you connect a language model, local or hosted. - 📦 **Check every word, keep every meeting.** Each meeting is one audio file that any player opens, with its transcript and summary inside. Listen while you read to verify what was said. The [format is open](https://format.gocassini.com), so your archive stays readable without Cassini. - 🔒 **Access follows the Talk room.** The people, groups and Teams in a room can open its meetings: recordings, transcripts and summaries. Search, tags and the CLI only reach meetings you can open. - 🗑️ **Keep the words, drop the audio.** Publish meetings as transcripts only and keep nothing on the server. Or set how long audio, video and published meetings are kept. - 🩺 **Run it from inside Nextcloud.** Setup, transcription models, storage and health checks all live in the app. The Doctor checklist tells administrators whether recording will work and fixes what it can. - 🛠️ **Build on your meetings.** A CLI and an agent skill let scripts and coding agents turn calls into notes, issues and plans, with the same permissions a person has.
## Getting started
1. Install Cassini from **Apps → External apps** (needs AppAPI with a HaRP deploy daemon). 2. Open Cassini and run the **Doctor** checklist. Paste your signalling server's `internalsecret` when it asks. 3. Optional: install a transcription model from **Settings**. CPU works; an NVIDIA GPU is faster. 4. Start a Talk call and press **Record**.
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 33.0.9 to 35 with AppAPI and a HaRP deploy daemon. - Talk's High-performance backend. - Nextcloud Files sharing enabled. No Team folders or Everyone Group app needed. - No GPU needed: CPU works on amd64 and arm64. As a rough guide, on an 8-thread desktop CPU the default setting transcribes an hour of audio in about 2 minutes, using 1.3 GiB of RAM. - Optional: an NVIDIA GPU with the Container Toolkit. The same hour takes about 15 seconds.
## What leaves your server
Recordings and transcripts never leave your hardware. When an administrator installs a transcription model, the server downloads it from `dist.gocassini.com`; nothing about your meetings is sent. If you configure a language model, transcript text goes to it for summaries and for questions people ask in the app. Nothing else is sent, and there is no telemetry. [Full privacy note](https://gocassini.com/docs/guides/privacy/).
## Listen to it in action
Listen to our [Nextcloud Conference 2026 talk](https://gocassini.com/nextcloud-conf-2026), played back in Cassini's own viewer with its transcript, summary and tags.
## Support
Questions and bugs: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/codemyriad/gocassini/issues).
**Need help deploying Cassini for your organisation?** [Book a 30-minute call](https://cal.eu/chris-de-sousa-fxpsnh/cassini-setup-call) with [Codemyriad](https://codemyriad.io) to talk through your setup.
## Ethical AI rating
### Speech-to-text (Moondream Parakeet Ultra): 🟠
The model of every quality tier on a GPU, and of Balanced and Best on a CPU: Moondream's post-training of NVIDIA Parakeet v3.
Positive: - the trained model is freely available (CC-BY-4.0), and runs on your own hardware - the software for inference is open source
Negative: - Moondream has not published the code it post-trained the model with - Moondream has not published its post-training data, apart from naming the MUSAN noise corpus; the NVIDIA training data underneath is only partly available
### Speech-to-text on a CPU's Fast tier (NVIDIA Parakeet 110M): 🟡
Positive: - the software for training and inference of this model is open source - the trained model is freely available (CC-BY-4.0), and runs on your own hardware
Negative: - the training data is only partly available: NVIDIA's NeMo ASR Set 3.0 includes licensed corpora
### Voice separation (NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization): 🟡
Positive: - the software for training and inference of this model is open source - the trained model is freely available (OpenMDW 1.1), and runs on your own hardware
Negative: - part of the training data is licensed from third parties and not freely available
Summaries and questions use whichever language model you connect, so their rating depends on that model. Learn more about the [Nextcloud Ethical AI Rating](https://nextcloud.com/blog/nextcloud-ethical-ai-rating/).

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_RECORDING_SECRET
variable.description: Shared secret for Nextcloud Talk's recording backend protocol. Must match the "secret" in Talk's recording_servers setting (occ config:app:set spreed recording_servers). Required for the Talk "Start recording" button: without it the operator rejects every recording request.

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_SIGNALING_INTERNAL_SECRET
variable.description: Shared internal secret for standalone Nextcloud Talk signaling / HPB. Must match the signaling server's [clients] internalsecret. Alternatively, leave this unset and save the secret in Cassini's recording checks (Operator, Doctor) after installation. Required for HPB-internal recording (the invisible recorder used for private, group, and one-to-one calls) — it cannot be auto-generated. How to find it: on Nextcloud All-in-One run `docker exec nextcloud-aio-talk printenv INTERNAL_SECRET`; on a standalone HPB it is the [clients] internalsecret in the signaling server config. See docs/exapp-install.md.

variable.name: CASSINI_TALK_BACKEND_URL
variable.description: Base URL the operator uses to call back into Nextcloud Talk (recording started/stopped notifications and recording upload). Leave empty to use the backend URL Talk sends with each recording request, which is correct for almost every deployment.

variable.name: CASSINI_NC_ADMIN_USER
variable.description: The Nextcloud administrator account Cassini uses to check whether its recordings account and built-in Files sharing are ready. Leave empty to detect an administrator automatically; set it only if detection picks the wrong account. Recordings themselves are stored by the dedicated "cassini" service account.

variable.name: CASSINI_PUBLISH_SINK
variable.description: Selects the publish destination: "nextcloud-files" stores recordings in the "cassini" service account's private Nextcloud Files tree and grants direct Files shares to captured Talk room participants. This is the default for an installed app and requires no additional Nextcloud app. "local" keeps recordings on the app's own volume for standalone development. Leave empty for the installed app. See docs/direct-shares-cutover.md for existing recordings.

variable.name: CASSINI_ARTIFACT_RETENTION
variable.description: Deprecated and ignored. Configure container-local retention in Operator → Storage. All categories default to keep forever; choose 7, 30, 60, 90 or custom days, evaluated on UTC dates. Successful duplicate working copies are cleaned independently. Job metadata is not evicted; expiry of published meetings in Nextcloud Files is a separate setting in Operator → Storage.

variable.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variable.description: Initial API key for the LLM summary endpoint (see LLM_BASE_URL), used to pre-fill the app's LLM settings on first start; afterwards manage keys in the app. Leave empty when the endpoint needs no key, as a self-hosted model server usually does not.

variable.name: LLM_BASE_URL
variable.description: Initial OpenAI-compatible API base URL for meeting summaries — a hosted provider or your own model server. It pre-fills the app's LLM settings on first start; afterwards endpoints are managed in the app without a redeploy. Leave empty to start with no LLM endpoint. Defaults to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 when OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set.

variable.name: LLM_MODEL
variable.description: Initial model identifier for meeting summaries (default: openai/gpt-4o-mini); pre-fills the app's LLM settings on first start.

variable.name: CASSINI_ROOM_ID_PEPPER
variable.description: Deployment-wide secret mixed into the one-way derivation of each meeting room id. Recommended. Choose it once: changing it gives future meetings new room ids, while already published recordings keep their ids.

variable.name: CASSINI_OPERATOR_API_TOKEN
variable.description: When set, direct (non-proxied) requests to the operator job API must send "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Requests proxied through Nextcloud are authenticated by AppAPI and are unaffected. Leave empty to keep the API reachable only through the AppAPI proxy authentication.

variable.name: CASSINI_STT_BACKEND
variable.description: Which registered speech-to-text engine transcription uses. Leave empty for the default (sherpa-onnx). An unknown value fails the build loudly before any audio is decoded, so a typo cannot silently select a different engine.

variable.name: CASSINI_DISALLOW_MODEL_DOWNLOAD
variable.description: Set to 1 to prevent speech-model downloads, including resuming interrupted downloads. Transcription is optional and defaults to off. Import manually transferred models with cassini models import, then enable transcription in Settings. Verified models persist across upgrades; recording and audio playback work without models.

variable.name: CASSINI_ATTRIBUTION_DISABLED
variable.description: Set to 1 to skip the cross-track speaker-attribution stage entirely. By default every word is annotated with acoustic evidence of who was speaking; no words are changed or removed either way.

variable.name: CASSINI_ATTRIBUTION_DROP
variable.description: Set to 1 to delete words the acoustic evidence contradicts instead of annotating them. Intended for room systems where one microphone audibly picks up every participant. The manifest records how many words were removed.
